summary.en: Takagi loses his notebook after breaking up a fight between a manager and his singer. He searches for his book with the help of Conan, Haibara, and the Detective Boys. Victim: Wataru Takagi Missing object: Police notebook Suspects: Jiro Hanzaki and Seiichi Sugiyama Takagi stopped by the park on the way home to break up a fight. He noticed his police notebook was missing the next morning, and assumed he must have lost it in the park during that time.
